sources.snippet: TNSA Curiosity TNSA Stable Curiosity is a transformer-based model architecture designed for casual language modeling tasks. It is an enhancement of the ARCH-X9 and NGen2 model, optimized for various NLP tasks such as text classification, token classification, and language generation.
